description: This file defines an internal interface ICancellationSourcesExtension used by Orleans grain cancellation runtime to propagate cancellation notifications to grains. It includes a method to cancel remote tokens asynchronously.

classes.name: ICancellationSourcesExtension
classes.description: An internal interface for propagating cancellation notifications to grains within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: CancelRemoteToken
methods.description: Asynchronously cancels a remote token identified by tokenId.
